sloka: स वार्यमाणो यक्षेण प्रविवेश निशाचरः ।यदा तु वारितो राम न व्यतिष्ठत्स राक्षसः ।। ७.१४.२६ ॥
transliteration: sa vāryamāṇo yakṣeṇa praviveśa niśācaraḥ ।yadā tu vārito rāma na vyatiṣṭhatsa rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.14.26 ॥

translations.english: Though obstructed by the Yaksha, the night-wanderer entered, and O Rama, when that demon was stopped, he did not halt.
